text:
The plate is about 26 cm across, and I estimated each item from that scale.

| Item | Weight | Energy |
|---|---|---|
| Meatloaf slices (2) | about 55 g and 75 g, so 130 g | about 220 kcal |
| Granola bars (2) | about 30 g each, so 60 g | about 280 kcal |
| Meatball or stuffing balls (2) | about 35 g each, so 70 g | about 130 kcal |
| Baked tofu pieces (4) | about 60 g | about 110 kcal |

The totals are about 320 g and about 740 kcal.

For the meatloaf, the larger slice is roughly 11 × 5 × 2 cm, which is about 110 g. The smaller one is about 80 g. That makes 190 g, or about 330 kcal at 1.7 kcal/g, so I revised the meatloaf figures upward.

The revised totals are about 380 g and about 850 kcal. That seems a bit high for a cafeteria serving, so I settled on a compromise.

{"kcal": 780, "mass_g": 350}
